evidence.detail: Uses data-sortInitialOrder attribute which feeds jQuery tablesorter — a client-side, in-page-only sort
Server-side query uses .paginate() with order_by=name only; no sort parameter accepted from the request
Decksite uses React-based live tables (data-* driven) that support server-side sort across the full dataset — no equivalent exists in logsite

bakert comment: 'The solution here is to use a React component like we use in DeckTable and CardTable' and later 'It's not of any great practical value to convert all the logsite tables to react components. Backlogging this.'

triage.notes: Bakert made a deliberate product call to backlog this; the engineering effort (converting logsite tables to React with server-side sort params) is substantial relative to its practical value since most logsite use cases are single-person recent matches.
